ci_status_observed: success; replay matched exact original frozen risk probabilities
type: postpublication experiment, not a prospective weekly forecast, not new future evidence
inputs_type: previously frozen subjective event probabilities, assumed normal volatility, common event shocks; NOT fitted economic distribution
measurement: Six equity Friday-to-Friday simple percent returns below or equal -1.5%; event count>=3 of S&P500, Nasdaq100, STOXX600, Nikkei225, KOSPI, CSI300.
method: Replicate original seeded 20,000-path generator byte-for-byte RNG ordering across all ten assets and all shared events, counting six equity marginals. Remove cross-market dependence mathematically by exact Poisson-binomial dynamic programming with the SAME empirically simulated six marginal tail probabilities. Retain each arm's marginal distributions; separate baseline stat->hybrid marginal shift from residual dependence.
inference: The hybrid event's 41.82% estimate exceeds statistical 26.60% largely because the hybrid model assigns higher individual downside probabilities to each equity; eliminating correlations leaves hybrid 40.02%, while common-shock dependence adds only ~1.80 pp under this scenario model. Neither relative number is a demonstrated market calibration improvement.
negative_evidence: Weakens the earlier informal story that the higher hybrid joint-event probability is mainly driven by explicit cross-market dependence. Does NOT falsify the prospective claim that *real-world* market co-crashes may be more correlated than an independent baseline.
prospective_test_boundary: Nov13 outcome must be compared against the ORIGINAL Nov7 frozen risk forecasts; this Sunday counterfactual can be examined only as a separate post-cutoff exploratory diagnostic. Start formal 26-week dual-model pre-registration from November14 or later as specified in existing 2026-11-07 hypothesis.
limitations: The model's same-marginals Poisson-binomial probability is computed from sampled subjective hybrid returns, not empirical return data.
Original 20,000 draws and five alternate seeds are Monte Carlo diagnostics, not six market observations or six prospective weeks.

Differences across original statistical and hybrid arms combine different marginal vol/means and event shocks; decomposition is conditional on chosen statistical reference and empirical draw marginals.
One Nov6 co-drawdown week cannot identify real market dependence or justify refitting shocks.
WTI and USDJPY provenance issues are irrelevant to the six-equity event definition but may influence broader model inputs.
